item.title: Ancient Romans loved their dogs. Here's what their heartbreakingly beautiful epitaphs said about them.
item.description: Ancient Romans—they're just like us. At least when it comes to how much they love their dogs, that is.Pliny the Elder (23–79 A.D.), the Roman author and scholar, described dogs as "man's most faithful companion" in his Naturalis Historia. He also wrote: "The dog alone knows his master, and he alone recognizes his own name.
